changelog:
CSM settings header search now orders results by relevance too: exact title, title prefix, title text, description, compatibility alias, then internal keys.
The same matching stays case-insensitive, keeps one owner per result and never writes settings while typing.
Dialog actions verified at real TV geometry: full 48dp targets and long labels stay inside the dialog, with the body text fully laid out.
message: Dev build v854 - Relevance-ranked CSM header search
